bridges.title: From field observations to instrumented measurements
bridges.practical_question: What is inadequately observed?
bridges.academic_question: What measurement validity and error models apply?
bridges.implementation_question: Which existing sensor/form systems can capture the signal?
bridges.economic_question: Who pays for measurement reliability, and does it replace an existing workflow?

bridges.title: Repair, refurbishment and circular re-use
bridges.practical_question: What assets lose usable value prematurely?
bridges.academic_question: Which failure modes and reliability limits determine repairability?
bridges.implementation_question: What diagnosers, parts inventories and repair instructions already exist?
bridges.economic_question: Can recovery cost plus warranty risk undercut replacement?

bridges.title: Matching surplus assets to time-sensitive needs
bridges.practical_question: Where do goods/services remain unused despite demand?
bridges.academic_question: What inventory, spoilage, scheduling and fairness constraints matter?
bridges.implementation_question: Which claims/reservation/dispatch systems work?
bridges.economic_question: What party bears coordination costs and could fund a service?

bridges.title: From forecast signal to measured resilience outcome
bridges.practical_question: Which communities face losses?
bridges.academic_question: Which hazard and outcome relationships are supported?
bridges.implementation_question: Which alert/response systems are field-deployed and maintained?
bridges.economic_question: Who funds preparedness and is an intervention purchasable?

bridges.title: Field survey integrity and sampling
bridges.practical_question: Where do missing/duplicated field observations distort decisions?
bridges.academic_question: Which sampling and missingness effects matter?
bridges.implementation_question: Which open form, capture and de-dup systems exist?
bridges.economic_question: Is an auditable data-quality service worth buying?

bridges.title: Operational optimization with real-world constraints
bridges.practical_question: Which decisions waste resources?
bridges.academic_question: What capacity/scheduling/bottleneck constraints explain loss?
bridges.implementation_question: Which solvers or schedulers solve compatible formulations?
bridges.economic_question: Does a measurable operating-cost saving exceed deployment cost?

bridges.title: Source-to-conclusion auditing
bridges.practical_question: Which decisions lack inspectable justification?
bridges.academic_question: What data lineage and uncertainty are required?
bridges.implementation_question: Which provenance registries or DAGs already exist?
bridges.economic_question: Who needs independently reproducible conclusions?

bridges.title: Link physical measurement to simulation
bridges.practical_question: Which prototypes lack reliable validation?
bridges.academic_question: How do models and real measurements differ?
bridges.implementation_question: Which open solvers and calibration tools can be joined?
bridges.economic_question: Would a calibrated service shorten design cycles?

bridges.title: Materials and chemical compatibility for repair
bridges.practical_question: What devices or components fail through material processes?
bridges.academic_question: What compatibility/aging/corrosion mechanisms are relevant?
bridges.implementation_question: Which repair methods/materials exist and meet safety constraints?
bridges.economic_question: Can compatibility checks lower repair failure rates?

bridges.title: Reproducibility and software acceptance
bridges.practical_question: Which workflows are unreliable or irreproducible?
bridges.academic_question: Which statistical/engineering guarantees are needed?
bridges.implementation_question: Which tests and reproducible pipelines can verify them?
bridges.economic_question: Could an operator pay for validation rather than a new product?

bridges.title: Anomaly discovery to documented investigation
bridges.practical_question: Where are misleading or anomalous signals costly?
bridges.academic_question: Which false-positive/counterevidence mechanisms must be distinguished?
bridges.implementation_question: Which trace/attribution tools already work?
bridges.economic_question: Would a public-interest actor fund defensible case investigation?

bridges.title: Electricity supply and load resilience
bridges.practical_question: Where is electricity access/cost/reliability binding?
bridges.academic_question: Which grid, storage and conversion constraints apply?
bridges.implementation_question: Which forecasting, control and electronics projects can be reused?
bridges.economic_question: What regulated installation and payback evidence is required?

bridges.title: Measure outcomes beyond operational throughput
bridges.practical_question: Which programs report activity without measuring actual benefits?
bridges.academic_question: Which causal counterfactual and outcome measures apply?
bridges.implementation_question: What implemented monitoring systems exist?
bridges.economic_question: Can an outcomes audit be funded by implementers or donors?

bridges.title: Private data access with auditable workflows
bridges.practical_question: Who needs to share sensitive records safely?
bridges.academic_question: What privacy and minimum-data principles apply?
bridges.implementation_question: Which identity and access-control modules are credible?
bridges.economic_question: Who bears compliance or trust costs?

bridges.title: Moving research into usable production workflows
bridges.practical_question: Which scientific methods remain inaccessible in day-to-day systems?
bridges.academic_question: What are the model assumptions?
bridges.implementation_question: Which packages and interfaces already exist?
bridges.economic_question: Who needs packaging, support or hosted infrastructure?

bridges.title: Physical engineering to editable electronic designs
bridges.practical_question: Which hardware lacks digital documentation?
bridges.academic_question: What is observable and reconstructable?
bridges.implementation_question: What OCR, tracing, EDA and 3D tools can interoperate?
bridges.economic_question: Is reconstruction cheaper than redesign or replacement?

bridges.title: Trace claims, propagation and independent verification
bridges.practical_question: Which narratives or reports affect decisions?
bridges.academic_question: How to separate fact, repetition and correlated sources?
bridges.implementation_question: What archive/claim graph systems exist?
bridges.economic_question: Who values independently checked evidence enough to sponsor it?

bridges.title: Reuse across incompatible engineering subsystems
bridges.practical_question: What practical assemblies fail due to interface friction?
bridges.academic_question: Which interface constraints and standards govern?
bridges.implementation_question: What adapters, middleware and device bridges exist?
bridges.economic_question: Can interoperability work create service demand?

bridges.title: Public demand versus open-source implementation supply
bridges.practical_question: Which requirements are in funded procurements?
bridges.academic_question: Which standards and accessibility laws apply?
bridges.implementation_question: Which OSS components could satisfy objective acceptance tests?
bridges.economic_question: Can a licensed integrator bid, and are terms viable?

bridges.title: Localized hosting, language and institutional workflows
bridges.practical_question: Which imported products fail local workflows?
bridges.academic_question: Which language, regulation and accessibility constraints matter?
bridges.implementation_question: Which maintained software is adaptable without violating licenses?
bridges.economic_question: Will organizations pay for localization and continuing support?

bridges.title: Engineering arbitrage before commercialization
bridges.practical_question: Where is a claimed opportunity based on weak or missing cost data?
bridges.academic_question: Which failures, uncertainty and opportunity costs determine expected payoff?
bridges.implementation_question: Which available systems make cheap controlled pilots possible?
bridges.economic_question: What buyer, rights, cost and execution evidence makes conversion viable?

conversion_modes.possible_value: License-cleared third-party software packaged into hosted/operated service
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Operational testing; explicit software rights; supported deployments; security/privacy; identifiable paying customer
conversion_modes.stopping_condition: No rights or no customer evidence

conversion_modes.possible_value: Scoped bug repair, dependency upkeep, reliability or production hardening
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Maintainer agreement; reproducible issue; task scope; budget/payout; acceptance criteria

conversion_modes.possible_value: Combine interoperable OSS capabilities into useful complete system
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Bounded interoperability proof; operator workflow; data rights; performance targets
conversion_modes.stopping_condition: No operational need or mismatched interfaces

conversion_modes.possible_value: Local language, institutional, regulatory and payment workflows
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Documented local requirement; legal scope; source license; deployment support budget

conversion_modes.possible_value: Audited collection, validation, analysis and longitudinal monitoring
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Sampling plan; consent/privacy; outcome definitions; buyer with ongoing need
Verified funded current issue; permission to claim; accepted payout conditions
conversion_modes.stopping_condition: No active bounty or payout process

conversion_modes.possible_value: Respond to specific published funded RFP
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Live notice; eligibility; procurement rights; delivery capacity; contract economics
conversion_modes.stopping_condition: Cannot bid or serve required location

conversion_modes.evidence_required: Parts availability; failure rates; safety; warranty; local supply/demand margin

conversion_modes.possible_value: Assemble and validate licensed open hardware designs
conversion_modes.evidence_required: BOM; build instructions; safety approval; inventory; tested unit economics

conversion_modes.possible_value: Convert under-supported upstream project into operated product or service
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Mutual agreement; brand/IP/data rights; ownership of support and revenue; buyer demand

conversion_modes.possible_value: Sell verification of implementations, contracts or claimed outcomes
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Independently checkable facts; sector process; buyer that values reduced uncertainty

conversion_modes.possible_value: Develop open-source public good against explicit grant milestones
conversion_modes.evidence_required: Call eligibility; project outputs; grant terms; sustainability beyond award
conversion_modes.stopping_condition: No eligible call or unfunded continuation
